about.intro:
The Island-Wide Virtual Premier League (IWVPL) is an independent esports organisation built by passionate gamers, for the community.
Unlike large organisations or associations, IWVPL is operated independently with the support of our valued sponsors. Every league, tournament, event, and community initiative is organised by our dedicated team, driven by passion rather than profit.
about.vision: To unite the EA SPORTS FC community across Southeast Asia on one platform.

faq.a: The Island-Wide Virtual Premier League is an independent esports organisation running competitive EA SPORTS FC events across Southeast Asia. We operate Pro Clubs (11v11), 1v1 FUT competitions and Champions League tournaments, with 2v2 competitions coming soon.
Our primary communities are Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Brunei. Anyone from these regions can register and compete.
IWVPL Pro Club Season 1 team registration is SGD 35 per team, covering one complete team entry pass with full access to all Season 1 league and playoff matches, plus prize pool eligibility.
IWVPL Pro Club Season 1 is capped at 36 teams. At the time of our latest announcement 18 teams had already registered, leaving 18 slots available.

faq.q: What happens after I purchase an entry?
faq.a: Your purchase does not immediately finalise registration. Please allow 24-48 hours for our admin team to verify and process your entry. You will then receive a confirmation email containing your team submission forms. Your entry remains pending until that confirmation is received and your roster is submitted.

faq.q: How are matches scheduled and reported?
faq.a: Team managers input and update match results directly through the Manager Portal, keeping league standings accurate in near real-time. Kick-off times are published in SGT and fixtures are listed on the schedule page.

faq.q: Are IWVPL competitions official EA tournaments?
faq.a: No. IWVPL is an independent league promoter and is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Electronic Arts Inc. EA SPORTS and EA FC are registered trademarks of Electronic Arts Inc.

faq.q: How can I get involved beyond competing?
faq.a: We warmly welcome new sponsors and business partners, community feedback, content creators and streamers, and volunteers who share our passion for growing the EA SPORTS FC scene. Reach us on Discord, Instagram or TikTok.

news.title: Are You Ready for the Ultimate 1v1 Showcase? IWVPL Champions League is Coming Soon!
news.excerpt: Hello IWVPL Community! The heat from the Pro Club League is still burning, and we’ve been overwhelmed by your incredible response. news.body: Hello IWVPL Community! The heat from the Pro Club League is still burning, and we’ve been overwhelmed by your incredible response. But we know many of you are also itching for a different kind of competition—the pure, head-to-head, raw-skill battle of 1v1 . We are absolutely thrilled to announce that the most anticipated game mode in IWVPL is on the horizon: the official IWVPL Champions League 1v1 is Coming Soon! This league is designed for those who believe in their personal skill above all. No more relying on a full squad—it’s just you, your controller, and your tactical brilliance against your opponent. What to Expect: Icons of European Football The Champions League mode will pit you against other players using only the most iconic clubs from top European flights. You will take control of giants like Real Madrid, Bayern Munich, Manchester City, Paris Saint-Germain , and others to conquer the league. This isn’t just about playing with any team; it’s about leading the grandest names in club football to IWVPL glory in a pure 1v1 showcase. Feature Spotlight: Select Your Dream Team, Your Way! We have a special feature in this league that we know you’ll love. In the IWVPL Champions League 1v1, players are not locked out from selecting the same team. Yes, you heard that right! If you are a die-hard Madridista and your friend is too, both of you can choose to compete as Real Madrid in your respective matches. There’s no need to pick a secondary team anymore—focus solely on mastering your favorite European side and prove who is the better manager and player. Key Information Coming Soon This is just the first taste. Detailed information regarding the following will be released in the coming weeks: League Format and Structure Registration Dates and Methods Prize Pool Details Start Dates and Schedules In the meantime, dust off your controllers, perfect your 1v1 strategies, and get ready to climb the ladder of the Champions League. The road to European dominance in IWVPL begins now. Keep your eyes on our website and social media channels for the next official update! — The IWVPL Admin Team

news.title: Pro Club League Update: Beta Phase and Massive Plans for Next Season!
news.excerpt: Hello managers and players! We want to give you a quick update regarding the current status of the Pro Club League here at the Island-Wide Virtual Premier League. The enthusiasm shown by the community so far has been absolutely incredible, and we want to ensure you all stay informed about the league’s development. 🧪 Current…
news.body: Hello managers and players! We want to give you a quick update regarding the current status of the Pro Club League here at the Island-Wide Virtual Premier League. The enthusiasm shown by the community so far has been absolutely incredible, and we want to ensure you all stay informed about the league’s development. 🧪 Current Status: The Beta Phase For your information, the current run of the Pro Club League is still in its Beta (testing) phase . This phase is crucial for our development and admin teams to test the competition systems, ensure stability, and figure out exactly what needs to be improved before we launch the league on a much larger scale. Even though we are still in Beta, we are incredibly proud to announce that we already have 18 officially registered teams actively participating and heating up the competition! We want to extend a massive thank you to all 18 teams for jumping in early and helping us perfect the ecosystem of this league. 🏆 What Awaits Us Next Season? Seeing the high level of interest and the burning competitive spirit from all of you, we are definitely not stopping here. We have already laid out massive plans to ensure next season is significantly bigger and more challenging! Here is a sneak peek at what we are preparing for the upcoming season: Expansion to 3 – 5 Divisions: To accommodate more teams and create a fairer competitive environment, we plan to divide the Pro Club League into 3 to 5 distinct divisions next season. This means the promotion and relegation system will be much more rigorous, and every team will compete against opponents that truly match their skill level. A Much Larger Prize Pool: As the league grows and divisions expand, we will also be offering a total prize pool that is significantly larger than before! Prepare your teams as best as you can, because fantastic rewards await the champions. Keep the Support and Feedback Coming! Keeping in mind that we are still in active development, feedback from our players and managers is incredibly valuable to us. Keep playing, compete fairly, and do not hesitate to provide suggestions or report any issues to the admin team. Let’s use this Beta phase to build a strong foundation for an epic next season. Keep honing your tactics, strengthen your teamwork, and get ready to face even bigger challenges! — The Island-Wide Virtual Premier League Admin Team

news.title: Welcome to the Official Island-Wide Virtual Premier League Website!
news.excerpt: Hello everyone, and welcome! We are incredibly thrilled to announce the launch of the official website for the Island-Wide Virtual Premier League. Moving forward, this website will serve as the ultimate central hub for our community. Whether you are a star player, a strategic team manager, or a dedicated fan, this is where you will…
news.body: Hello everyone, and welcome! We are incredibly thrilled to announce the launch of the official website for the Island-Wide Virtual Premier League . Moving forward, this website will serve as the ultimate central hub for our community. Whether you are a star player, a strategic team manager, or a dedicated fan, this is where you will find everything you need to know about the league. 🚧 Pardon Our Dust: We Are Still in Development While we couldn’t wait to open our digital doors to the public, please keep in mind that the website is currently still under active development . You might notice that a few pages are missing, or some areas look a bit bare. Don’t worry! Our development team is working hard behind the scenes to build a robust, feature-rich platform that matches the passion and competitive spirit of our league. Expect to see many new features, visual improvements, and quality-of-life updates rolling out in the near future. 🚀 Sneak Peek: What is Coming in the Next Update? We are already gearing up for our first major update, which will completely transform how you interact with the league. Here is a look at the exciting features coming soon: For Players: Register & Login: Create your own secure personal account. Profile Customization: Personalize your presence in the league! You will be able to edit your profile, update your player information, and showcase your unique identity to the rest of the community. For Team Managers: Manager Portals: Dedicated registration and login access specifically for team managers. Team Customization: Take full control of your club’s identity. You will be able to customize your team’s page, update logos, and manage your roster. Match Management: Managers will have the ability to input and update match results, keeping the league standings accurate and up-to-date in real time. Note: We will announce the exact release date for these features very soon, so be sure to check back regularly! Thank You for Your Support! We want to give a massive thank you to our entire community for your continued support and patience as we build this platform. The Island-Wide Virtual Premier League is about to get a whole lot bigger, and we are glad you are here for the journey. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready for an amazing season ahead! — The Island-Wide Virtual Premier League Admin Team
